title: RuntimeTokenConfig
description: Schema contract for the RuntimeTokenConfig frozen dataclass governing token processing runtime parameters.

combine_source_words.description: Whether to combine source words during token processing.

combine_order.description: Order used when combining source words (e.g. 'alphabetical', 'frequency').

prefer_lowercase.description: Whether combined or resolved tokens prefer lowercase normalization.

filter_by_window.description: Whether inflected forms are filtered against a sliding context window.

apostrophe_chars.description: Characters treated as apostrophes during token boundary analysis. Must be a Unicode string, not OS-path-encoded.

token_mappings_enabled.description: Whether custom token mapping rules are applied during processing.

lemmatize_mapped_tokens.description: Whether tokens resolved via mapping rules undergo further lemmatization.
